title: 第六十五章 复叶徽章 瞎编的第六十四章 推到娜姿
content_zh:
原本朝着红莲道馆林萧三人来到一处不知名的森林中，让林萧郁闷的是，三人在森林中转了一天都没有走出来。
“林萧，你确定这是去洪红莲岛的路？红莲岛不是在海边吗？”芽衣疑惑的询问林萧。
拿出地图查看的林萧，越看脸越黑，自己居然迷路了！活了两辈子的林萧还是第一次遇上迷路这种事。
而且还不是一般的迷路，三人走的方向完全和红莲岛的方向差了十万八千里，自己竟然带着芽衣和娜姿往红莲岛的反方向走......
林萧苦笑道：“确实不是去红莲岛的路，因为我们迷路了，走了反方向，这座森林叫做复叶森林。”
“迷路！！”这对三人是多么陌生的词语，如今落在他们头上。
芽衣哭笑不得抱着皮丘说道：“那现在怎么办？我们离红莲岛这么远，该怎么过去？”
娜姿则是一脸无所谓，走到哪里她从来不关心。
“是有点远，”林萧看着森林的另一边说道：“既然来了，我就先走出森林，森林外面有一个叫复叶的小镇，那个小镇上也有道馆。等拿到这里的徽章后再去红莲岛做最后的挑战吧。”
芽衣耸耸肩膀示意随便，确定路线，林萧三人顺着森林的小路向复叶镇走去。
“迷！”
迷你龙自己从精灵球里跑出来，四处张望。
林萧黑着脸喊道：“不是告诉你不准随便从精灵球里跑出来吗？昨天才提醒过你，今天你就开始犯错了.....”
“迷~~”迷你龙很委屈的垮着小脸，示意自己不是故意的。
娜姿抱着拉鲁拉丝微微一挑秀美，对林萧说道：“它说它想要训练，不想呆在精灵球里。”和拉鲁拉丝建立心灵感应的娜姿从拉鲁拉丝那里可以知道小精灵在说什么，简直就是一大作弊器。
娜姿说出自己的意思，迷你龙很高兴的眯着小眼睛，摇着尾巴。
拜托，你是龙好不好？能不能留点尊严，摇尾巴这事是你该做的吗？
不过既然迷你龙自己跑出来要求训练，林萧自然不会拒绝，将沙袋从背包里拿出，为它绑上。还好这个世界的背包都有折叠空间，可以装下很多东西，而重量不会增加，不然光是背包里的东西就能把林萧压趴下。
既然迷你龙开始训练，林萧自然将其他的几只放出来一起，森林蜥蜴、可达鸭都加入队伍中，至于其他几只，这种训练跑步锻炼体力的方法对它们起到的作用已经微乎其微。
“好了，大家跑起来，当做体能训练。”林萧拍拍手带着小精灵带头前行，芽衣和娜姿跟在后面。

在森林跑步可不容易，特别是迷你龙这种没有脚的小精灵.....格外痛苦，遇到坎子和坑洞都要费着很大的劲拽着沙包爬。
“呜~~”
林萧带着小精灵跑步的时候忽然看到路边上一颗小树下，一只受伤的小火龙坐在地上抱着脚痛苦的嗷叫，火红色的肌肤上布满汗水。
“停下！”
林萧对身后喊了一声，跑到小火龙身边，弯下腰，轻声道：“小火龙，你的腿受伤了，让我给你治疗好吗？”
小火龙警惕的看着林萧，使劲摇头，腿上的剧痛让小火龙痛得冷汗直冒在身体的高温下又很快蒸发，喘着粗气，显然受伤不轻。
林萧皱起眉头，小火龙对自己很警惕，不放它放松警惕自己没法治疗。
小精灵们也围着小火龙，叽叽喳喳说个不停，希望它能放松心情让林萧治疗。
可不论怎么劝解，小火龙死活不准林萧接近，搞得林萧差点被他喷出的火焰烧到。
“林萧怎么了，”芽衣和娜姿刚上来就看到，小火龙对脸小喷火焰的一幕。
林萧擦擦额头被小火龙吓出的冷汗，说道：“娜姿你问一下，小火龙因为什么事受得伤，它对人类抱有很大的敌意。”
“拉丝~”跪在地上，拉鲁拉丝，开始和小火龙交流。
“呜~~~”身为感知兽的拉鲁拉丝，很容易和其它小精灵接触，在拉鲁拉丝的询问下，小火龙逐渐敞开心扉。
content_en:
Originally heading towards the Red Lotus Gym, Lin Xiao and the three of them came to an unknown forest. What made Lin Xiao depressed was that the three of them wandered in the forest for a whole day without coming out.
"Lin Xiao, are you sure this is the way to Honglian Island? Isn't Honglian Island on the beach?" Yayi asked Lin Xiao doubtfully.
Lin Xiao took out the map to check, and his face grew darker as he looked at it. He was actually lost! After living two lifetimes, this was the first time that Lin Xiao encountered getting lost.
And it’s not just an ordinary way of getting lost. The direction the three of them were walking in was completely different from the direction of Honglian Island. He actually took Mei and Nazi to the opposite direction of Honglian Island...
Lin Xiao smiled bitterly and said: "It is indeed not the way to Red Lotus Island, because we got lost and went in the opposite direction. This forest is called the compound leaf forest."
"Lost!!" This is such a strange word to the three of them, but now it falls on them.
Meiyi couldn't help but hugged Pichu and said, "What should we do now? We are so far away from Red Lotus Island, how should we get there?"
Nazi, on the other hand, looked indifferent and never cared where she went.
"It's a bit far," Lin Xiao looked at the other side of the forest and said, "Since I'm here, I'll walk out of the forest first. There is a town called Fuye outside the forest. There is also a gym in that town. After you get the badge here, you can go to Red Lotus Island for the final challenge."
Yayi shrugged her shoulders and said it was casual. After confirming the route, Lin Xiao and the others walked along the forest path towards Fuye Town.
"Mystery!"
The mini dragon itself ran out of the poke ball and looked around.
Lin Xiao shouted with a dark face: "Didn't I tell you not to run out of the elf ball casually? I just reminded you yesterday, and you started making mistakes today..."
"Mysterious~~" The mini-dragon looked aggrieved, showing that he didn't do it on purpose.
Nazi hugged Lalu Lasi, slightly raised her beauty, and said to Lin Xiao: "It said it wanted to train and didn't want to stay in the elf ball." Nazi, who had established telepathy with La Lulas, could know what the elf was talking about from La Lulas, which was simply a cheating device.
Nazi said what she meant, and the mini dragon narrowed its eyes happily and wagged its tail.
Please, are you a dragon? Can you please have some dignity and wag your tail? Is this what you should do?
But since the mini dragon came out and asked for training, Lin Xiao naturally would not refuse. He took the sandbag out of his backpack and tied it on. Fortunately, the backpacks in this world have folding space and can hold a lot of things without increasing the weight. Otherwise, just the contents of the backpack would weigh Lin Xiao down.
Now that the mini dragons have started training, Lin Xiao naturally released several others together. Forest lizards and ducks have joined the team. As for the other ones, this method of training and running to strengthen their physical strength has had minimal effect on them.
"Alright, let's start running, this is just for physical training." Lin Xiao clapped his hands and led the elf to take the lead, with Yayi and Nazhi following behind.
Running in the forest is not easy, especially for an elf like a mini dragon without legs...it is particularly painful. When encountering obstacles and potholes, you have to drag sandbags with great effort.
"Woo~~"
When Lin Xiao was running with the little elf, he suddenly saw an injured little fire dragon sitting on the ground under a small tree on the roadside, holding his feet and screaming in pain. His fiery red skin was covered with sweat.
"Stop!"
Lin Xiao shouted behind him, ran to Charmander, bent down, and whispered: "Charmander, your leg is injured, please let me treat you?"
Charmander looked at Lin Xiao warily and shook his head vigorously. The severe pain in his leg made Charmander break into a cold sweat, which quickly evaporated under the high temperature of his body. He was breathing heavily, and it was obvious that he was seriously injured.
Lin Xiao frowned. The Charmander was very wary of him, and he couldn't cure it if he didn't let it relax its vigilance.
The elves also surrounded the little fire dragon, chattering non-stop, hopingIt can relax the mind and allow Lin Xiao to heal.
But no matter how he tried to persuade him, Lin Xiao was not allowed to come near the little fire dragon, and Lin Xiao was almost burned by the flames he breathed out.
"What's wrong with Lin Xiao?" Yayi and Nazhi saw the Charmander spitting out flames as soon as they came up.
Lin Xiao wiped the cold sweat on his forehead from being frightened by the Charmander, and said: "Nazi, please ask, what caused the Charmander to be injured? It is very hostile to humans."
"Lux~" Kneeling on the ground, pulling Lulu, began to communicate with Charmander.
"Woo~~~" As a sentient beast, Lalu Lasi can easily come into contact with other elves. Under Lalu Lusi's questioning, Charmander gradually opened up his heart.
